topic.title: A topic in Lightweight DITA
topic.shortdesc: This topic is XDITA: the editor loads it, and saves it as it is, with its id.

body.p: Each part of it is an element of the editor, with its DITA name: a short description, a body, its sections and their titles.

li.p: Put the cursor here: the breadcrumbs show the path of the DITA elements.
Press Enter at the end of an item for the next one, and in an empty one to leave the list.

note.p: Right-click an element for its menu, or press Alt+Enter to insert an element where the cursor is.

section.title: Code and links
section.pre: const topic = editor.getData(); // The topic, as XDITA.
section.p: A cross-reference keeps its target: DITA. Click it to see its attributes.
